title.zh: 无公理实践判断的独立接续

scope.zh: Ren 后来明确重新授权的会话范围；不撤销已完成 G0/J 路线。
scope.en: The session explicitly reauthorized later by Ren; it does not revoke completed G0/J work.

objective.zh: 检验更强的普遍实践权威根据。
objective.en: Investigate the stronger ground of universal practical authority.

premises.zh: 保留整体关系与真实对手，不能用弱表示中的自由谓词开关否定完整理论。
premises.en: Retain whole relations and substantive rivals; freely toggled predicates in a weaker representation do not refute the fuller theory.

completion.zh: 完成标准取自原指示和当前目标；已有局部证明不得冒充中心主张完成。
completion.en: Use the original directive and current target; local proofs cannot substitute for the central result.
